ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer (roycho96 fork)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team (forked by roycho96)
ModMetaData.description: [FORK] Private fork of rwmt/Multiplayer with extra desync fixes for hanne's MP group. Original: https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer (MIT, see LICENSE) This fork: https://github.com/roycho96/Multiplayer Added on top of upstream master: - Float non-determinism fix (StatWorker.GetValue + Frame.workDone decimal rounding via transpiler) - TabStorageWrapper NRE guard at wrapper creation + ThingComp sync InvalidCastException pattern guard - Designator_Plan_Add SelectedPlan UI-state leak fix (Desync-24): serialize issuer's SelectedPlan, route reads/writes through ThreadStatic PlanCommandContext during command replay ⚠ Same packageId as upstream — do NOT subscribe to both. Unsubscribe the original workshop Multiplayer before enabling this fork. Original description: Place right below Core and expansions. Requires RimWorld >= 1.6.4491. FAQ - https://hackmd.io/@rimworldmultiplayer/docs/ Discord - https://discord.gg/S4bxXpv
